beats: A child gets stuck on a printed textbook page with no digital copy to check.
Someone dug up the real book, flipped to the page, and worked out the homework by hand — every time, even for pages explained before.
Now one photo of the page is read once, and the answer is saved in a database.
Next time that page comes up again, it's just pulled back up.
Read once, reused forever — no page gets explained twice.
